provenance.purpose: Synthetic style demonstration, not experimental results.
provenance.sample: 24 synthetic participants, all retained in every panel.
provenance.response: One artificial response used in all panels; no EEG/harmonic selection.
provenance.scores: Three artificial score vectors, no clinical interpretation.
provenance.multiplicity: All three predeclared demonstration comparisons form one BH family.

spearman.p_method: Synthetic demonstration only. Two-sided Monte Carlo permutation of average tied ranks, 99,999 shuffles, plus-one p, NumPy PCG64 seed 20261104.
spearman.correction_method: Benjamini-Hochberg across all three synthetic correlations.
